decision_rules.phase: Promote selected tokens only if at least one passes all gates; otherwise continue unless audit method integrity cannot be repaired.
decision_rules.promotion: All gates pass per token, remains experimental.
decision_rules.reject: Both independent humans fail positive consistency with sufficient cohort coverage and reviewable sample.
decision_rules.segmentation: Authoritative evidence of an invalidating dated change, not just token absence.

gates.auditability: All sample, excerpt, receipt, reviewer and protocol claims authenticate to independently supplied roots; hashes cannot reconstruct discarded article bytes.

cross_year.eligible_years: sampled years with positive candidate population; absent-token years explicitly untested

gates.documentation: Provider supports expected topical interpretation, not necessarily classifier precision.
gates.taxonomy: Pass only with bounded affirmative version/change evidence supporting comparison; undocumented history remains unresolved. Known invalidating change requires segmentation.
gates.uncertainty: Important extractor/identity/selection limitations must be bounded; unresolved material issues prevent promotion.

labels.ambiguous: Relevant context exists but supports competing reasonable semantic readings; not a replacement for clear mismatch or missing text.
labels.contextual_topic_match: A meaningful causal, policy or explanatory connection to the concept; not merely a passing name.
labels.direct_topic_match: Substantive explicit discussion of the expected concept; prospective or historical topic discussion counts when substantive.
labels.document_unavailable: No successful bounded public article retrieval, including HTTP/network/unsupported-response failure.
labels.incidental_or_weak_match: Genuine concept mentioned only in passing, background or an unrelated list.
labels.insufficient_context: Accessible response cannot establish article identity or adequate semantic context, including blocked pages, homepage/replacement redirects and uncertain extraction.
labels.semantic_mismatch: Sufficient context establishes a different subject or lexical/metaphorical collision, without substantive expected concept. Do not conceal clear mismatch as ambiguous.

retrieval.cache: source-content SHA256 + token + extractor/protocol hash; review cache additionally pins excerpt, prompt, model and settings; no cached judgment without independent receipt root
retrieval.identity_policy: HTTP success is not article identity proof. Cross-host or changed path (except scheme/trailing slash) and homepage responses require manual identity verification. No automatic topic labeling.
retrieval.method: bounded public HTTP(S) GET; original address only; redirects logged
retrieval.selection: Complete sentence containing concept cue, with adjacent complete sentence when word budget permits; cue locates evidence, never assigns semantics. If unavailable, bounded complete paragraph/title fallback and manual-context flag.

review.adjudication: No automatic majority adjudication; gate must pass for both independent human reviewers. Disagreement remains visible.
review.blinding: none; year/source shown, no prevalence or expected conclusion in packet
review.human_requirements: Two independently registered genuine human reviewers; registry must be supplied by trusted operator, not inferred from submitted annotations. No manufactured human reviews.
review.llm_role: not used; optional future secondary assistance requires separate explicit reviewer registration
review.machine_role: retrieval and context preparation only, never topical ground truth

sampling.2015_wb_absence: No eligible tagged rows; allocation zero, semantic outcome not evaluated; no inferred negative.
sampling.deduplication: Exact DocumentIdentifier globally unique; fixed token order and lexicographic cohort order. Canonical earliest batch/line row per token/reference; content duplicates retained as retrieval outcomes but count once per token/year analysis.
sampling.edge_strategy: Per token/cohort select one lowest and one highest distinct-theme-count row (ties by seeded rank), then fill by seeded rank. Metadata richness is an edge proxy, not a semantic label.
sampling.population: Accepted Phase 3 rows with exact V1THEMES token and public HTTP(S) DocumentIdentifier in original 96 archives.
sampling.shortfall_policy: record unfilled slots, never expand other cells post hoc
